ănătīnus , a, um, adj. id.,
I.of or pertaining to the duck: Utinam fortunam nunc [ego] anatinam uterer, Uti quom exivissem ex aquā, arerem tamen, * Plaut. Rud. 2, 6, 49.—Hence, ănătīna , ae, f. (sc. caro), duck-flesh, duck, Petr. 56, 3.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
